title: Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d)
description: About the Role at RobCo RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. As our Senior Electrical Engineer - Robotics (m/f/d), you act as the electrical core of our robotics engineering team, taking complete ownership of our hardware platforms from early prototyping through to series production. You bridge high-speed autonomous robotic development with robust engineering processes, ensuring our hardware meets the highest quality and safety standards, and set up efficient systems and engineering gates that empower the broader team to work with clarity, focus, and speed. Your Responsibilities Own the full electrical picture: Design and execute schematic capture, multi-layer PCB layout, cable harness design, connector selection, and part specification. Drive end-to-end prototyping and series production: Build PCBs, circuits, and wiring systems, taking dynamic initial concepts all the way through to scalable manufacturing. Establish engineering processes: Build standard QA frameworks, engineering gates, and operational systems that allow the team to stay focused, execute rapidly, and succeed. Ensure quality, compliance, and safety: Act as the primary gatekeeper for electrical quality while navigating applicable industry safety standards and regulatory compliance. Engine for high-speed execution: Balance fast-paced autonomous robotic iteration with pragmatic, right-sized QA processes tailored to current development stages. Design motion system architectures: Develop and optimize 24V/48V power distribution, motor/servo drive integration, and sensor interfaces to ensure high signal integrity and thermal efficiency. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with firmware and software teams on board bring-up, microcontroller integration, and system-level debugging. Manage DFM/DFT and supplier relationships: Work directly with contract manufacturers and in-house assembly teams to oversee BOM costs, component sourcing, and engineering change control. We're looking for someone who has: Completed vocational training or a degree in Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a comparable field. Several years of experience in full-cycle electrical design (analog, digital, and power circuits) across multiple companies, taking products from concept to market. Deep technical background in Altium, multi-layer PCB layout, microcontrollers (ARM Cortex, STM32), motion systems (24/48V power, motor drives, encoders, sensor interfaces), and EMC/thermal layout strategies. Solid grasp of DFM/DFT principles, cable harness design, signal integrity, and direct collaboration with contract manufacturers. Proactive, end-to-end ownership mindset with a pragmatic working style and a drive to establish scalable processes in a high-growth environment. Very good English skills (German is a plus). Nice to have: Familiarity with industrial protocols (EtherCAT, Profinet, Modbus, CAN, Ethernet) and exposure to relevant standards/safety concepts (CE/Machinery Directive, ISO 10218, EMC standards, STO, PL/SIL). Why join RobCo? Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation. Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time. As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work. Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development. Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously. Flexible working hours, a modern office, and—depending on the role—the option to work from home. Regular team events—from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest. About RobCo Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model. We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco. Don’t meet every single requirement? title: Revenue Operations Associate
description: Revenue Operations Associate Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ) Deine Mission Die Energiekosten in Europa sind doppelt so hoch wie in den USA und China. Gleichzeitig wird sich die Stromnachfrage bis 2050 voraussichtlich verdoppeln. Marktpreisvolatilität und zunehmende Komplexität werden uns erhalten bleiben. Damit steht das Rückgrat der europäischen Industrie unter Druck – und Unternehmen müssen jetzt handeln. trawa entwickelt die Lösung: die erste integrierte B2B-Energieplattform, die Energiebeschaffung, Energiemanagement und die Steuerung von Flexibilitäten in einem Produkt vereint. Supply, Manage, Flex – kombiniert. Diese Integration ermöglicht Einsparungen von bis zu 30 % bei den wiederkehrenden Stromkosten und unterstützt Unternehmen gleichzeitig dabei, auf erneuerbare Energien umzusteigen. Wir sind Europas am schnellsten wachsende B2B-Energieplattform. Aktuell sind wir in Deutschland und Österreich aktiv und planen, unsere Aktivitäten 2027 auf einen dritten Markt auszuweiten. Unser Ziel ist die europaweite Skalierung. Wir bewegen uns schnell – das Marktfenster ist offen, und wir wollen es nutzen. Über trawa trawa ist ein Scale-up mit Sitz in Berlin und rund 100 Mitarbeitenden, davon etwa 30 in Product & Tech. Bis heute haben wir mehr als 35 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, darunter eine Series-A-Finanzierungsrunde über 24 Millionen Euro im Mai 2025. Zu unseren Investoren zählen Balderton, Headline, Speedinvest, AENU, Magnetic und Tiny VC. Alle drei Gründer sind weiterhin aktiv dabei und zu 100 % committed, das Energieversorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft aufzubauen. Das Team Unser Revenue-Operations-Team ist ein zentraler Wachstumstreiber für den kommerziellen Erfolg von trawa. Es verbindet verschiedene Teams miteinander, schafft effiziente Prozesse und befähigt unseren Vertrieb, sein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen. Dadurch entsteht ein dynamisches Umfeld, das nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht. Deine Aufgaben Angebotserstellung (Configure-Price-Quote): Du verantwortest den Angebotsprozess und erstellst auf Basis von Kundendaten maßgeschneiderte Energiekonzepte – von passgenauen Stromversorgungsangeboten bis hin zu Batteriespeicherlösungen für die Industrie. Deal-Analyse und Pricing: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Account Executives und der Vertriebsleitung zusammen, um Deals ganzheitlich zu bewerten - dabei erkennst du Ausnahmen und Besonderheiten, weist auf sie hin und koordinierst die notwendigen Freigaben mit den zuständigen Ansprechpartnern. CRM & Deal-Management: Du verantwortest das Deal-Management in unserem CRM – einschließlich der Zuordnung von Deals in Deal-Phasen, der korrekten Erfassung von Produktkategorien und Umsätzen Vertragsmanagement: Du prüfst Verträge für unsere Großkund:innen und stellst sicher, dass unser Vertragswerk passgenau zu ihren Anforderungen passt. Vertriebsstrategie und Planung: Du unterstützt bei Pipeline-Reviews, Forecasts sowie bei der allgemeinen vertrieblichen Steuerung. Was du mitbringst Du denkst analytisch und arbeitest gerne mit Daten. Auffälligkeiten entgehen dir nicht – du gehst ihnen systematisch auf den Grund und identifizierst ihre Ursachen. Du gehst Probleme strukturiert und mit Neugier an. Auch bei einer zunächst unklaren Fragestellung findest du immer eine gute Lösung. Du kommunizierst schriftlich klar und präzise und arbeitest gerne mit internen Stakeholdern sowie Kund:innen und Vertriebspartnern zusammen. Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Auge für Details. Ob ein fehlendes Datum oder eine uneinheitliche Definition einer Kennzahl – du erkennst solche Unstimmigkeiten bevor sie zum Problem werden. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System wie HubSpot oder Salesforce ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend ist, dass du bereit bist, dich schnell und gründlich in neue Systeme einzuarbeiten. Deine Ziele Nach sechs Wochen: Du hast ein fundiertes Verständnis zu unserem Geschäftsmodell, unserem Produkt und den energiewirtschaftlichen Kontext aufgebaut. Du hast alle wichtigen internen Stakeholder aus Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, Finance und Product kennengelernt und verstehst, wie die einzelnen Teams mit Revenue Operations zusammenarbeiten. Du hast unser CRM-, CPQ- und Reporting-Setup vollständig kennengelernt und kannst dich selbstständig in Deal-Daten und Pipeline-Ansichten orientieren. Du hast einen vollständigen Deal-Zyklus begleitet – von der Opportunity bis zum unterschriebenen Kundenvertrag – und verstehst unseren aktuellen Deal-Desk-Prozess und hast schon erste kleinere Verbesserungspotenziale identifiziert. Nach drei Monaten: Du steuerst unsere Deal-Desk-Prozesse selbstständig. Du hast dich als verlässliche Ansprechperson im Unternehmen bei Fragen rund um Deals und die Angebotsprozesse etabliert. Du identifizierst kontinuierlich Optimierungspotenziale in unseren Prozessen und treibst ihre Weiterentwicklung aktiv voran. Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft Du arbeitest gerne mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und unterstützt sie mit pragmatischen, passgenauen Lösungen. Du kommunizierst klar, verbindlich und auf Augenhöhe. Du gehst Aufgaben mit Eigeninitiative und klarer Zielorientierung an. Du denkst analytisch und strukturiert: Komplexe Prozesse zerlegst du gerne in einzelne Schritte, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und Metriken. Erfahrung in der Energiewirtschaft ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Warum trawa? Wirkung: Europäische KMU geben jährlich zwischen 150.000 und 10 Millionen Euro für Strom aus – viele davon zahlen zu viel und sind an veraltete Beschaffungsmodelle gebunden. Mit unserem Produkt veränderst du unmittelbar, wie Tausende Unternehmen Energie einkaufen, managen und nutzen. Die Wirkung ist messbar, der Markt ist riesig und der Zeitpunkt ist jetzt. Verantwortung: Bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Themen und treibst Ergebnisse voran – unabhängig von deinem Hintergrund oder deiner bisherigen Berufserfahrung. Lernen und Entwicklung: Wir stellen dir ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget und feste Zeit für deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung zur Verfügung. Dich erwarten Mentoring, vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und echte Perspektiven für deinen nächsten Karriereschritt. Vielfalt und Inklusion: Wir sind ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit lebt, und unser Team spiegelt das wider. Menschen aus mehr als 15 Nationen bringen unterschiedliche Sprachen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Bei trawa ist Familienfreundlichkeit auf allen Ebenen selbstverständlich – in unserem Team und in der Führung arbeiten Eltern. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem alle ihr Bestes geben können. Vergütung und Benefits: Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket mit Gehalt und Stock Options, 30 Urlaubstagen sowie zahlreichen Benefits. Dazu gehören Zuschüsse für Internet und Mittagessen, eine Mitgliedschaft im Sport Club, feste Lerntage mit jährlichem Weiterbildungsbudget, ein wöchentliches Team-Mittagessen und regelmäßige Teamevents. Bei trawa bauen wir einen vielfältigen, inklusiven und authentischen Arbeitsplatz auf. Wenn dich die Position begeistert, dein bisheriger Weg aber nicht in allen Punkten dem Anforderungsprofil entspricht, freuen wir uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bist du genau die richtige Person für diese oder eine andere Position bei uns. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
description: At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms. As a Senior Robotics Engineer , you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments. Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation. Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness. Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions. Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces.  Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture. Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions. Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure. Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection. Support hardware bring-up, integration and system validation in laboratory and field environments. Analyse test results, debug complex system behaviour and continuously improve system robustness. Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle. Support flight and field testing of autonomous Drone Port capabilities. Contribute to software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to the technical growth of the robotics team. What you bring to the team: Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline. Several years of professional experience developing robotic or autonomous systems. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python. Experience developing embedded software in C/C++. Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including: Perception State estimation Sensor fusion Motion planning Feedback control Experience with robotic middleware such as ROS or ROS2. Experience integrating cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, UWB, radar or similar sensors. Familiarity with computer vision libraries such as OpenCV. Experience implementing real-time control systems. Experience with machine learning for robotic perception. Experience with Linux-based embedded systems. Familiarity with Git and modern CI/CD development workflows. Strong systems thinking and the ability to work across software, electronics and mechanics. Experience with autonomous vehicles, UAVs, industrial robotics, mobile robots or automated machinery is highly desirable. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent English Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. title: Werkstudent UX Project Management & Design Operations (m/w/d)
description: Du liebst die Welt des UX-Designs, hast jedoch mehr Spaß an Organisation und Kommunikation als am reinen Design-Prozess? Du möchtest dafür sorgen, dass kreative Umsetzung und das Management von Kundenwünschen perfekt Hand in Hand gehen? Du hast Lust, deine Stärken in einem Startup-Team einzubringen, das über reine Designdienstleistung hinaus soziale und ökologische Verantwortung übernimmt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Peak Studio ist ein wachsendes Design-Startup mit Fokus auf Klarheit, Konsistenz und nachhaltige Wirkung. Wir glauben, dass Design Verantwortung trägt – gegenüber unseren Kunden ebenso wie gegenüber der Welt, in der wir leben. Deshalb entwickeln wir anstatt kurzlebiger Kampagnen ganzheitliche, zusammenhängende Markensysteme und skalierbare Strukturen, die Bestand haben. Unseren Kunden bieten wir Design auf Subscription-Basis über 3 maßgeschneiderte Abo Modelle an – passgenau für alles, was ihr Unternehmen braucht. Über einen zentralen, agilen Workflow liefern wir Ergebnisse schnell, konsistent und ohne das häufige Projektchaos. Aufgaben Wir suchen einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der unser Design-Team strukturiert, unseren kundennahen Subscription-Workflow koordiniert und als kompetenter Ansprechpartner an der Kundenschnittstelle agiert. Deine Aufgaben bei uns: Schnittstelle & Kommunikation: Du bist das zentrale Bindeglied zwischen unseren Kunden und dem internen UX/UI-Design-Team. Anforderungsmanagement: Du nimmst Kundenwünsche in Meetings auf, hinterfragst diese kritisch und übersetzt sie in klare, verständliche Briefings für die Designer. Projektkoordination: Du steuerst Design-Sprints, überwachst Timelines und organisierst die internen Feedbackschleifen. Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Kunden-Präsentationen, moderierst Abstimmungstermine und stellst sicher, dass die Erwartungen auf beiden Seiten matchen. Qualifikation Passendes Studium: Du studierst aktuell im Master (z. B. UX-Design & Management, Design-Management, Strategic Design, oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang). Kommunikationstalent: Du hast großen Spaß am direkten Kundenkontakt, trittst professionell sowie selbstsicher auf und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte einfach erklären. Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch bei parallelen Projekten den Überblick und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für ein dynamisches Startup-Umfeld mit. Konzeptionelles UX-Verständnis: Da dein Schwerpunkt in der Organisation und Kommunikation liegt, steht ein Design-Portfolio für uns nicht im Vordergrund. Wichtig ist uns jedoch, dass du UX-Methoden und die Logik von Designsystemen tiefgreifend verstehst, um mit Kunden und Designern auf Augenhöhe zu kommunizieren. Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sowie eine sichere und fließende Kommunikation auf Englisch (in Wort und Schrift). Benefits Flexibilität: Die Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro im Herzen Münchens oder nach Absprache Remote zu arbeiten, um Job und Studium optimal zu vereinbaren. Projekt-Impact mit Sinn: Unser Anspruch endet nicht beim Design. Wir verbinden effektive Gestaltung mit sozialer und ökologischer Verantwortung. Mit unserer Arbeit unterstützen wir unter anderem den Schutz von Ökosystemen und die Stärkung indigener Gemeinschaften in Südamerika und Asien. Mitgestaltung: Die Möglichkeit, die operativen Strukturen und Workflows einer wachsenden Designagentur von Grund auf aktiv mitzugestalten. Teamkultur: Ein ambitioniertes Team, flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedbackkultur auf Augenhöhe. Entwicklung: Eine steile Lernkurve im Bereich Design Operations und agilem Projektmanagement sowie regelmäßiger, direkter Austausch mit den Gründern. Die Rolle und unsere Philosophie sprechen dich an, du bist dir jedoch nicht sicher, ob du alle Punkte erfüllst? Du analysierst die Recruiting-Herausforderungen der Unternehmen, identifizierst konkreten Handlungsbedarf und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte Strategien. Du präsentierst deine Lösungen überzeugend und begleitest den Prozess bis zum Abschluss. Recruiting – du setzt sie um: Nach Vertragsabschluss steuerst du das Projekt eigenständig weiter – von der Kampagnenplanung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung. title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
description: At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms. As a Senior Robotics Engineer , you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments. Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation. Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness. Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions. Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces. Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture. Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions. Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure. Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection. Support hardware bring-up, integration and system validation in laboratory and field environments. Analyse test results, debug complex system behaviour and continuously improve system robustness. Collaborate closely with Mechanical, Electrical and Systems Engineering throughout the complete product development lifecycle. Support flight and field testing of autonomous Drone Port capabilities. Contribute to software architecture, coding standards and engineering best practices. Mentor junior engineers and actively contribute to the technical growth of the robotics team. What you bring to the team: Master's degree or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline. Several years of professional experience developing robotic or autonomous systems. Strong programming skills in modern C++ and Python. Experience developing embedded software in C/C++. Strong understanding of robotics fundamentals including: Perception State estimation Sensor fusion Motion planning Feedback control Experience with robotic middleware such as ROS or ROS2. Experience integrating cameras, IMUs, LiDAR, UWB, radar or similar sensors. Familiarity with computer vision libraries such as OpenCV. Experience implementing real-time control systems. Experience with machine learning for robotic perception. Experience with Linux-based embedded systems. Familiarity with Git and modern CI/CD development workflows. Strong systems thinking and the ability to work across software, electronics and mechanics. Experience with autonomous vehicles, UAVs, industrial robotics, mobile robots or automated machinery is highly desirable. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Fluent English Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile working: If it gets too turbulent for you in our office, you can get the necessary balance through mobile working. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. Lunch-Card: Be powerful with delicious energy, daily lunch budget is sponsored. Company Shuttle: Enjoy our convenient shuttle service that picks you up from Pasing in Munich and brings you to our location, with return trips at the end of the workday. About us: Quantum Systems specialises in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in defence, security, public sectors. raw.title: Mid Market Account Executive (m/w/d) - Germany
raw.description:
About Multiverse StackFuel

Multiverse x StackFuel is the leading provider of data and AI upskilling programmes in Germany.

In 2025, StackFuel was acquired by Multiverse and we are now building our GTM engine for the enterprise and mid market, to replicate the UK trajectory in Germany. As a Mid Market Account Executive, you get the best of both worlds: StackFuel’s local expertise and product-market fit combined with Multiverse’s GTM leadership, sales playbooks and resources.

Together with our customers, we are redefining how people learn and work, enabling organisations to successfully navigate AI adoption.

Our mission is to open up new career paths for people around the world through practical, future-proof training in data and AI, while helping organisations build the capabilities they need for the digital age.

In this role as an Mid Market Account Executive, you will play a direct and visible part in advancing this mission with our mid market customers in Germany.

 
 

The role

As an Mid Market Account Executive, you are uniquely positioned to accelerate AI adoption and enablement by delivering a value proposition that sits at the core of German mid market’ transformation strategies:

  • Own a portfolio of strategic mid market accounts in Germany.

  • Be responsible for winning new customers and growing existing ones.

  • Manage the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing.

You’ll work closely with Customer Success, Marketing and Product to bring the best of Multiverse StackFuel to our customers and drive measurable business outcomes for them.

 
 

What you’ll do

  • Ramp up quickly on the Multiverse GTM playbook, supported by market‑leading sales training and a strong development culture.

  • Apply and master the MEDDICC methodology to qualify, manage and scale your pipeline and opportunities.

  • Own new business activities in our most strategic mid market accounts – including building and nurturing relationships with decision-makers at C‑level and C‑2.

  • Deeply understand your prospects’ challenges around digital transformation, capacity, capabilities and diversity – and position Multiverse StackFuel solutions in a way that clearly links to their strategic priorities and business outcomes.

  • Systematically build champions to win new logos, convert upsell and cross-sell opportunities, and develop accounts into strategic key accounts.

  • Build, grow and manage your own portfolio of strategic existing customers with a long-term, value-based approach.

 
 

What you’ll bring

  • You have 3+ years of closing experience in an mid market B2B sales environment

  • You have a proven track record in creating and driving new business and are always looking for ways to grow business with your clients through strategic approaches

  • You can build and deliver a thorough end-to-end sales process

  • Proven top performance in previous roles, with strong target orientation and a clear drive to win.

  • You are high energy and driven to continually raise the bar in terms of performance and expectations

  • Fluent German and very good English skills, both written and spoken.

  • Strong interest in technological developments in AI and in how these can be translated into effective learning experiences.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with MEDDICC or a similar qualification framework.

  • You’re bringing an SDR/BDR background

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package with base salary and performance-based commission.

  • Hybrid working culture with modern offices in Berlin, Munich and Düsseldorf.

  • A mission-driven environment at the intersection of education, data and AI.

  • Dedicated budget and time for learning and professional development.

  • Collaborative, supportive team culture with regular feedback and coaching.

How we hire

  1. Intro call with Talent

  2. Interview with Hiring Manager, Regional Director

  3. Challenge Interview with our VP for Germany, Frank Wenzel

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team and encourage applications from all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

raw.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Als Head of Learning & Product Expansion (w/m/d) verantwortest Du die strategische Weiterentwicklung und Skalierung unseres Learning-Portfolios und unserer Prozesse im deutschsprachigen Markt. Du verbindest Markt- und Produktperspektive, befähigst unsere Learning-Organisation in Deutschland und stellst sicher, dass unsere AI-, Data- und Engineering-Programme als produktisierte Services wachsen, die skalierbar, compliant und kommerziell erfolgreich sind.

Du kommst zu Stackfuel und Multiverse in einer entscheidenden Phase ihrer Wachstumsgeschichte. Dich begeistert die Vision, Teil eines europäischen Scale-ups zu sein und Dir gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit bietet, im Netzwerk die Zukunft des Lernens mitzugestalten. Du denkst Lernen nicht nur als Inhalte und Curricula, sondern als Produkt, das skalieren, neue Märkte erschließen und sich an regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen anpassen kann. Themen wie Product-Market-Fit, die Grenzen dessen, wo Bildung und Technologie reale Weiterbildung transformieren können, und das Finden sowie Fördern der richtigen Talente in deinem Team treiben dich an.

Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle:

 

Produkt- & Portfoliostrategie (DACH & Europa)

  • Verantwortung für das deutschsprachige Learning-Portfolio und die Roadmap mit klarem Fokus auf Marktbedarfe und exzellente Lernerfahrungen

  • Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Führungskräften, um Lernstrategien zu recherchieren und zu empfehlen, die staatlich geförderte und kommerzielle Go-to-Market-Kanäle optimal nutzen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Expert:innen, um Programme zugleich compliant, attraktiv und wirtschaftlich tragfähig zu gestalten

  • Befähigung Deines Team, neue Chancen in AI, Data und Engineering zu analysieren und in Programme mit belastbaren Business Cases zu übersetzen – dabei wirst Du auch selbst operativ bei wichtigen Kund:innen aktiv

  • Aufbau datengetriebener Routinen, um die Produktqualität beim Skalieren zu überwachen und die Priorisierung von Wartung und Weiterentwicklung zu steuern

AI-native Learning & Automatisierungsstrategien

  • Entwicklung und Optimierung einer AI-unterstützten Content-Produktionspipeline gemeinsam mit Expert:innen im Multiverse-Netzwerk und deinem Team (z. B. Agents, automatisierte Workflows, AI-basierte Analytics)

  • Einsatz von Daten, KPIs und Automatisierungstools zur Steuerung von Portfolio-Performance, Programmqualität und Skalierbarkeit

  • Aktive Erkundung neuer Formen dynamischer, AI-nativer Lernerfahrungen gemeinsam mit dem UK-Learning-Team und lokalen Expert:innen

Teambuilding & skalierbare Delivery

  • Schnittstelle zwischen Learning und anderen Bereichen: Weitergabe wichtiger Updates, Eskalation von Risiken und Förderung einer Kultur der Zusammenarbeit im gesamten Unternehmen

  • Rekrutierung, Onboarding und disziplinarische Führung von Teammitgliedern, einschließlich Führungskräften

  • Begleitung des Teams durch Wachstum und Veränderung und Etablierung einer Kultur, die unsere Operating Principles lebt

  • Förderung einer „AI-first“-Kultur, in der Automatisierung genutzt wird, um Kapazitäten für komplexere Aufgaben zu schaffen

  • Steuerung flexibler Ressourcen (z. B. Content-Partnerschaften oder Freelancer), um Expertise und Delivery gezielt zu unterstützen

Skalierung & Internationalisierung unserer Learning-Produkte

  • Lokalisierung und Anpassung erfolgreicher UK-Programme für den DACH-Markt und weitere Regionen (Sprache, Regulierung, Zielgruppen, Pricing)

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines skalierbaren „Education-as-a-Service“-Angebots inklusive Programme, Plattform (LXP) und Services

  • Mitverantwortung für Go-to-Market-Strategien neuer Angebote und Segmente gemeinsam mit Product, Product Marketing und Sales

  • Aufbau wirkungsvoller Netzwerke mit UK- und europäischen Partnern, um deutsche Best Practices zu teilen und Impulse aus anderen Ländern aufzunehmen

 

Das bringst Du mit

 

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Produktstrategie, Programm-/Portfoliomanagement oder Venture-/Business Building – idealerweise in EdTech, SaaS oder einem anderen technologiegetriebenen Umfeld

  • Nachweisliche Verantwortung für Portfolios oder Product Roadmaps inklusive Budgetierung, Ressourcenplanung und Skalierung

  • Hohe Technologieaffinität und Erfahrung mit AI-, Data- oder digitalen Plattformprodukten – du musst nicht selbst coden, kannst aber komplexe Lösungen schnell verstehen

  • Erfahrung im Markteintritt und in der Kommerzialisierung neuer Angebote (neue Länder, Segmente oder Geschäftsmodelle)

  • Vertrautheit mit regulierten Bildungsumfeldern (z. B. staatlich geförderte Trainings, Akkreditierungen) oder stark regulierten Branchen (Banken, Gesundheitswesen etc.)

  • Führungserfahrung in dynamischen, schnell wachsenden Organisationen und ein Track Record im Aufbau und Management cross-funktionaler Teams sowie externer Partner

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Daten, KPIs und AI-/Automatisierungstools zur Steuerung von Portfolio-Performance, Auslastung und Produktqualität

  • Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Skills – du fühlst dich im Gespräch mit CTOs, CAIOs, HR-/L&D-Leiter:innen ebenso wohl wie mit internen Teams

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse

Das bieten wir Dir

 

Arbeitskultur
Dich erwartet eine lösungsorientierte und datengetriebene Arbeitsweise, eine offene Feedbackkultur sowie ein starker Teamspirit. Zwei vom gesamten StackFuel-Team gewählte Trustees unterstützen Dich bei Fragen und Anliegen als neutrale, vertrauliche Anlaufstelle.

Ownership
Übernehme ab dem ersten Tag Verantwortung, bringe Deine eigenen Ideen aktiv ein, gestalte Prozesse nachhaltig und präge unsere Abläufe maßgeblich mit.

Hybrides Arbeiten
Wir arbeiten in einem hybriden Modell und sind üblicherweise 3 Tage pro Woche vor Ort in unserem Office in Berlin.

Workation
Bis zu 10 Tage pro Jahr kannst Du von überall aus der EU, dem EWR und der Türkei arbeiten.

Raum für Austausch
Regelmäßiger Austausch im Team, saisonale Feiern und eine immer gut gefüllte Küche sorgen für ein lebendiges Miteinander.

Weiterentwicklung
Absolviere unsere Online-Trainings, um Deine fachlichen Fähigkeiten auszubauen und Dich zur Expert:in für Daten und KI zu entwickeln.

title: Staff Product Designer, Mobile focus
description: KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world’s leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We’re also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business. As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is in our DNA and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. KAYAK is seeking a Staff Product Designer, Mobile to own the design direction across our apps and lead the craft of every designer who works on them. This is a senior individual contributor role with manager-level scope: you carry the design direction and UX/UI patterns across three teams (Apps Meta, Apps Retention, and Mobile Design Systems) while still designing and shipping yourself. You set the quality bar for all Apps design output, you hold it across teams, and you keep engineering pointed at the right work. You are the technical lead for apps design, accountable for the quality and velocity of what the apps designers produce, without managing them directly. This role is required to work from our Berlin office 3 days per week. In this role, you will: Own the design direction and the UX/UI pattern system across the apps surface. Navigation, mental models, and UI consistency cut across Apps Meta, Retention, and Design Systems at once, and you hold that cross-cutting direction so three teams ship one coherent experience rather than three versions of it. Set the quality standard for apps design and hold it as a discipline, not a project. Make the bar visible where teams miss it, and close gaps across teams that you did not personally create. title: Werkstudent Prozessoptimierung & KI (m/w/d)
description: Dein neues Team: Du möchtest verstehen, wie moderne Technologien Geschäftsprozesse nachhaltig verbessern, und diese aktiv mitgestalten? Du interessierst Dich für den praxisnahen Einsatz von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Automatisierung und digitalen Tools, ohne selbst tief in der Softwareentwicklung tätig zu sein? Dann bietet Dir diese Werkstudentenstelle die passende Kombination aus Business-Verständnis und technologischem Innovationsfokus. In unserem Team arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, Prozessen und Technologie. Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen analysierst Du bestehende Abläufe in unseren Kundenbereichen, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und unterstützt dabei, technologische Lösungen strukturiert und wirksam in den Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren. Das erwartet Dich: Prozesse & Anforderungen strukturieren: Du analysierst Abläufe, hebst Effizienzpotenziale und machst Prozesse sowie Anforderungen klar dokumentiert und umsetzbar. KI-/Automation-Use-Cases greifbar machen: Du unterstützt dabei, Use-Cases zu bewerten, zu schärfen und in Konzepte mit messbaren Erfolgskriterien zu übersetzen. Pilot & Umsetzung supporten: Du begleitest Tests, sammelst Feedback, hältst Learnings fest und hilfst, Verbesserungen in den Alltag zu bringen. Schnittstelle zu den Fachbereichen: Du koordinierst Abstimmungen, bereitest kurze Status-Updates/Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor und sorgst für Transparenz im Fortschritt. Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Du triffst Dein Team einmal pro Woche in unserem modernen Büro in Düsseldorf; an den übrigen Tagen arbeitest Du flexibel im Homeoffice. Das bringst Du mit: Studium mit wirtschaftlich-technischem Bezug: Du bist eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d), z. B. in Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Ingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Analytisches und strukturiertes Denken: Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu durchdringen, Prozesse logisch zu strukturieren und darzustellen sowie Verbesserungspotenziale herauszuarbeiten. Interesse an Technologie & Digitalisierung: Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an KI, Automatisierung und digitalen Innovationen mit und möchtest deren Einsatz im Unternehmenskontext verstehen. Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich vermitteln, sowohl auf Deutsch als auch auf Englisch. Eigeninitiative & Teamfähigkeit: Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst eigene Ideen ein und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams. Das bringen wir mit: Flexible Arbeitszeiten : Gestalte Deinen Arbeitstag so, dass er optimal zu Deinem Studium passt – wir unterstützen Deine individuellen Bedürfnisse! Möglichkeit zur Arbeit im Homeoffice : Arbeite dort, wo Du Dich am wohlsten fühlst. Ob im Büro oder von zu Hause – Du entscheidest! Flache Hierarchien : Bei uns wird Teamarbeit großgeschrieben! Du hast direkten Kontakt zu Entscheidungsträgern und kannst Deine Ideen einbringen. Vielfältige Gestaltungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten : Du hast die Chance, Deine eigenen Projekte zu leiten und Deine Fähigkeiten in einem dynamischen Umfeld weiterzuentwickeln. Zahlreiche bereichsübergreifende Events : Knüpfe wertvolle Kontakte und erlebe unser Team bei spannenden Veranstaltungen und Teamevents. Vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Fitness First oder Urban Sports Club : Bleib fit und gesund – wir fördern Dein Wohlbefinden mit attraktiven Fitnessangeboten! Täglich frisches Obst, endlos Kaffee, Tee und Wasser : Genieße eine gesunde Snack- und Getränkebar, die Dir hilft, energisch durch den Tag zu kommen. Rabatte über Corporate Benefits : Profitiere von exklusiven Angeboten und Rabatten auf zahlreiche Produkte und Dienstleistungen – ein zusätzliches Plus für Deinen Geldbeutel! Schließe Dich unserem Team an und bewirb Dich noch heute! Vergiss nicht, uns Dein voraussichtliches Ende des Studiums, Deinen gewünschten Stundenlohn sowie Dein nächstmögliches Startdatum mitzuteilen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Deine Bewerbung zu erhalten! Für uns als Arbeitgeber sind Chancengleichheit und Diversität besonders wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns auf Bewerbungen von Müttern, Vätern, Menschen mit Behinderungen und Menschen aus der LGBTQIA+ Community. Bitte teile uns gerne mit, wenn wir z.B. ein geschlechtsneutrales Pronomen verwenden sollen, Du einen barrierefreien Zugang zu unserem Büro benötigst oder wir mehr Zeit für den Bewerbungsprozess einplanen sollen. consistently keep contact and opportunity records up to date to deliver predictable forecasting to the sales leadership team</li> <li>Forecast accurately and develop the necessary pipeline to meet/exceed quota.</li> <li>Take ownership of the end-end sales processes in your territory, targeting folks in marketing, advertising, ecommerce, consumer insights, strategy/innovation and market research.</li> <li>Close deals by researching opportunities, prospecting, initiating discussions, building relationships, and conducting discovery calls and demos. This is an end-to-end new business sales role and no task is too small or too large.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desired Skills &amp; Experience:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years of B2B sales experience, with a strong preference for demonstrated consultative sales experience and a proven ability to sell data-driven insights or market research.</li> <li>Proven track record of success consistently exceeding sales quotas in a full-cycle new business role through strategic prospecting and territory planning.</li> <li>Expertise in managing complex deals from discovery and executive-level communication to pricing negotiation and contract closure.</li> <li>Deep industry relevance, with experience selling directly to business leaders across marketing, advertising, media, CPG, technology, or consumer insights.</li> <li>Strong operational discipline, including accurate pipeline management and forecasting within Salesforce or a similar CRM.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Salary &amp; Benefits:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Competitive salary based on skills, experience, and competencies.</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance including Bank Holidays.</li> <li>Comprehensive health benefits, including Private Medical Insurance and Health Cash Plan.</li> <li>Life assurance coverage for added peace of mind.</li> <li>Employee assistance programme for mental health and well-being support.</li> <li>Industry-leading family leave policies and access to our family benefits platform, Maven.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div><strong>About EMARKETER</strong></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>EMARKETER is the world's leading research company focused on digital transformation. We hire people who are passionate about providing business leaders with actionable data and insights in the areas of digital marketing and advertising, media, retail and ecommerce, financial services, healthcare, and more. Our clients, who rely on our content to make informed decisions, include top global brands within Fortune 1000 companies, as well as smaller firms striving to compete in a digital age.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>At EMARKETER, we pride ourselves on an inclusive work environment and continuously strive for diversity of thought, identity, and experience while encouraging growth and providing support to team members throughout the organization. EMARKETER is committed to corporate transparency through regular business updates and an always-open line of communication.&nbsp;</div> <div> <p><strong>What We Value</strong></p> <p>Our people are the foundation of our success. Guided by our values, we:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Serve Our Clients:</strong> We prioritize their needs to deliver excellence in our products and services.</li> <li><strong>Work as One Team:</strong> We collaborate with trust, accountability, and transparency.</li> <li><strong>Innovate and Adapt:</strong> We foster curiosity, resilience, and fearless exploration of new ideas.</li> <li><strong>Celebrate Diversity and Inclusion:</strong> We embrace a diverse, inclusive environment where all voices are valued and respected.</li> </ul> To learn more about what it’s like to work at EMARKETER check out our <a href="https://www.emarketer.com/careers/" target="_blank">careers page</a> and <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/emarketer-inc/life/33872e1c-1370-485f-ba86-e31902442c55/" target="_blank">life page</a>.</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>If this sounds like a great job for you, please apply online and tell us a bit about why you're a good fit for the role.</em><br><em>Please note that for all positions at EMARKETER, there is an exercise component specific to the role to reduce selection bias in our recruiting process and test how you apply knowledge.</em></div></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the Role

We are looking for a Growth Analyst to run marketing and growth analytics in our rapidly evolving multi-product app. As Lendable scales its products across lending, engagement features and other financial services, the complexity and volume of data-driven decisions have grown exponentially. This role is central to unlocking insights that will shape our drive acquisition efficiency and fuel product innovation, overseeing the full breadth of digital and non-digital channels across multiple products.

You'll be the analytical voice across our Zable direct marketing initiatives. Day to day you'll be maintaining and improving our customer lifetime value (LTV) models, running experimentation, owning growth reporting, and maintaining our attribution models. You'll work closely with product, growth, and engineering to make sure decisions are grounded in reliable data.

 
 

What You'll Do

Impact & Analytical Leadership

  • Maintain, monitor, and refine our customer lifetime value models across products and channels

  • Analyze marketing campaign performance across multiple channels and conduct analyses to identify trends and opportunities for optimisation

  • Structure and execute high-impact analyses in acquisition funnels to inform marketing spend and product evolution

  • Drive experimentation rigor: design, implement, and analyze A/B tests, multivariate experiments, and cohort studies

  • Turn experiment results into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Influence data architecture by contributing to schema design that enable more insights

  • Build high quality, scalable pipelines and transformations that increase interpretability of data and increase the teams’ agility

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Drive recommendations on channel optimisation and marketing spend

  • Serve as a thought partner to Product Managers and Credit Managers - ensuring analytical insight drives roadmap prioritisation and credit assessments.

  • Collaborate with the creative and design team to deepen insights at the creative and campaign level to enhance prioritisation of their ideas.

What We're Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data analytics, ideally within a product-led or high-growth tech environment

  • Deep expertise in analytical methods including LTV modelling, cohort analysis and regression techniques.

  • High proficiency in SQL and strong command of one or more analytics tools or statistical packages (e.g., Python, R).

  • Hands-on experience with DBT and familiarity with data modelling best practices

  • Skilled in experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, hypothesis testing, causal inference).

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous problems into structured, hypothesis-driven, data-supported insights.

  • Excellent communication skills with experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and product leaders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in credit marketing (credit cards, loans)

  • Experience building customer lifetime value models

  • Experience with paid media platforms (Google Ads, Meta, Tiktok etc.) and working with marketing teams

Interview process:

  • Screening call for initial fit

  • Take home Technical

  • Take home debrief

  • In-person interview (of which, cultural interview + marketing analytics interview)

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

briefs, print/mail production, logistics and vendor management Strong grasp of targeting and measurement: segmentation, holdouts, incrementality testing, attribution A commercial communicator who can function from scratch Familiarity with credit/lending offers, pre-approval and risk-based targeting Background hiring and developing an analytics or marketing team You’re a good fit if you’re: thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom Hands-on early, scaling later: you’re comfortable being the team, and the pipeline, for a while Disciplined about growth: you and stand up the data pipeline: first-party and third-party/enrichment data that feeds targeting Own segmentation, holdouts and incrementality testing so every send is measured and improving Creative, About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential offline channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Marketing & CRM to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, but also the analytical core that makes it work, building the response model and sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.   • Strong grasp of targeting and measurement: segmentation, holdouts, incrementality testing, attribution

  • A commercial communicator who can earn the trust of finance, data, product and engineering

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Familiarity with credit/lending offers, pre-approval and risk-based targeting

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or marketing team

  • Operator and analyst in one: you can run the sends and build the model that decides them

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not pieces mailed

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Hands-on early, scaling later: you’re comfortable being the team, and the pipeline, for a while

raw.title: Direct Marketing Growth Manager
raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential offline channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail & CRM to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, but also the analytical core that makes it work, building the response model and sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment. You’ll be equally at home briefing a creative and writing the SQL: someone who can scale the channel rapidly, but sustainably, anchored to our LTV data rather than raw volume.

This is a rare hybrid role. You’ll be both the operator running a physical, logistically demanding channel and the model-builder (with a team to support) deciding who we mail and why. If you want the autonomy to build a channel from the data up, and the budget and product depth to make it a top-of-funnel powerhouse, this is it.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 7+ years across direct mail, CRM, lifecycle or performance marketing, with at least 2–3 years owning a channel or function end-to-end

  • Hands-on with data: you personally build response/propensity models and write the SQL/Python to source, clean and join the data behind them

  • Track record scaling a measurable acquisition or retention channel with real commercial impact (CAC, ROI, incremental LTV)

  • Fluent in the economics: you size, forecast and defend a channel on unit economics and LTV, not volume

  • Comfortable running the operational side: creative briefs, print/mail production, logistics and vendor management

  • Strong grasp of targeting and measurement: segmentation, holdouts, incrementality testing, attribution

  • A commercial communicator who can earn the trust of finance, data, product and engineering

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow (analysis, creative, modelling, automation)

Desirable:

  • Experience in financial services, regulated or other consumer categories where offers and eligibility matter

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Familiarity with credit/lending offers, pre-approval and risk-based targeting

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or marketing team

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • Operator and analyst in one: you can run the sends and build the model that decides them

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not pieces mailed

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Hands-on early, scaling later: you’re comfortable being the team, and the pipeline, for a while

  • Disciplined about growth: you scale fast, but never faster than the LTV data supports

  • Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing

Channel Strategy & Scaling:

  • Own the direct mail strategy end-to-end and set ambitious, LTV-anchored targets for volume, response and payback

  • Scale the channel rapidly but sustainably, expanding sends only as far as the economics justify

  • Own the P&L view of the channel: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline

Response Model & Data Pipeline:

  • Build the response/propensity model that decides who we mail, with what offer, and when

  • Source and stand up the data pipeline: first-party and third-party/enrichment data that feeds targeting

  • Own segmentation, holdouts and incrementality testing so every send is measured and improving

Creative, Offers & Execution:

  • Brief and iterate on creative, copy and offer design to lift response and conversion

  • Run sends, print production and logistics end-to-end, managing vendors and turnaround

  • Optimise the offer strategy against eligibility, risk and lifetime value

Reporting, Team & Cross-functional:

  • Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

  • Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers

  • Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

  • Experience producing reporting packs and commentary for senior finance or capital markets audiences

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with risk, finance and capital markets teams

  • Experience in consumer lending or cards businesses

  • Curious and proactive, you seek out inconsistencies and improve processes before problems arise

  • Collaborative and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-moving environment

  • A structured thinker who can manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously

raw.title: Talent Sourcer - Tech
raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

The role

We’re looking for a Technical Sourcer to join our growing Talent team. You'll play a critical role in helping us identify, engage and attract exceptional talent across Engineering, Product, Data Science, Credit/Risk and other technical functions.

Working closely with Talent Partners and hiring leaders, you'll combine deep market intelligence, creative sourcing strategies and data-driven decision making to build high-quality talent pipelines for some of our most important hiring challenges. You'll be someone who enjoys solving difficult talent problems, uncovering hidden talent and continuously improving how sourcing gets done.

What you'll be doing:

  • Building and executing sourcing strategies for technical and hard-to-fill roles, using market mapping, talent intelligence and creative search techniques to identify exceptional talent

  • Partnering closely with Talent Partners and hiring managers to understand hiring goals, shape search strategies and deliver high-quality candidate pipelines

  • Proactively engaging passive talent across multiple channels, creating compelling outreach approaches that drive strong response and conversion rates

  • Using data and funnel insights to optimise sourcing performance, track progress and inform hiring decisions

  • Acting as a trusted market expert, sharing talent intelligence, competitor insights and market trends to help influence hiring strategies

  • Exploring and leveraging AI and modern sourcing tools to improve efficiency, uncover talent faster and enhance candidate engagement

What we offer:

  • Real impact: see your work directly shape the trajectory of our company. The talent you identify will fuel our growth and help us achieve ambitious goals

  • Growth: join and learn from driven, smart teammates who push for better, daily

  • High agency: you'll own your projects end-to-end, experiment with new ideas and have the autonomy to make meaningful contributions

  • Low ego: we value humility, transparency and the willingness to listen. No politics, just mutual respect and shared wins

  • Best of both: we're a financially solid fintech with a start-up mentality. Enjoy the stability and resources alongside the pace, autonomy and fun of a scrappy challenger brand

What we're looking for:

  • Significant experience as an in-house Sourcer within a fast-paced, product-led technology company, with a track record of supporting technical hiring across functions such as Engineering, Product, Data Science and Risk

  • Strong market mapping and sourcing capability, with the ability to build talent pipelines from scratch and uncover high-calibre passive talent in competitive markets

  • Proficiency with sourcing tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and other talent intelligence platforms, alongside a curiosity for exploring new ways to find exceptional people

  • A data-driven mindset, using sourcing metrics, funnel insights and market intelligence to optimise performance and influence hiring outcomes

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience partnering effectively with recruiters, hiring managers and wider talent teams

  • Curiosity for AI and modern recruiting technologies, and a desire to continuously improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate experience and team productivity

Interview process:

  • Screening: 30 minute call with our Senior Sourcer

  • Task: 15 minute online cognitive assessment

  • Onsite interview: 45 minute task presentation with our Head of Talent and Lead Talent Partner

  • Remote interview: 30 minutes with our Chief of Staff

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

As Compliance Monitoring Officer, you'll join Lendable's Compliance team to help ensure the firm meets its regulatory obligations and delivers good outcomes for customers. You'll design and deliver structured compliance monitoring reviews across the business, identifying risks and gaps, and working with stakeholders to track remediation to completion. This is a hands-on, detail-driven role for someone who understands consumer credit regulation and wants to build a strong second-line assurance function within a fast-moving fintech.

You'll report into the Compliance and Governance Manager, working closely with teams across the business as well as external bodies including the FCA and ICO.

Your team's objectives:

  • Deliver a robust, well-evidenced compliance monitoring programme across the firm

  • Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies at all times

  • Identify and escalate compliance risks, breaches, or suspicious activity before they cause harm

  • Provide second-line assurance over the effectiveness of Quality Assurance activities

  • Keep the business ahead of regulatory change through horizon scanning

  • Embed Consumer Duty and good customer outcomes across the organisation

How you'll impact those objectives:

  • Design terms of reference, testing logs, and comprehensive final reports for each monitoring review

  • Present findings to senior management and drive agreed actions to completion

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready records across all stages of monitoring activity

  • Review and validate the effectiveness of Quality Assurance work as second-line assurance

  • Support regulatory reporting, horizon scanning, and ad hoc compliance advice requests

  • Investigate and escalate potential breaches or unusual patterns to the right internal and external stakeholders

What do you need to succeed in this role:

  • 2+ years' experience in compliance monitoring within consumer credit, ideally including secured lending products

  • Solid knowledge of financial services regulation (AML, KYC, GDPR, DISP, CONC, MCOB)

  • Strong grounding in risk assessment methodologies and compliance monitoring techniques

  • A 2:1 degree (finance, law, business, or related) plus 3 A-levels at grade B or above; ICA or similar a plus

  • Sharp analytical skills with strong attention to detail and the ability to interpret data and spot patterns

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership across a broad remit. You are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people, who are relentlessly resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  3. Build the best technology in-house, using new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

The Role

We're building our second charge mortgage product from the ground up. We're looking for a Credit & Commercial Manager to own credit strategy for this product — someone who understands the mechanics of secured lending end-to-end, from quote through to completion.

This is a foundational hire. You'll shape how we assess risk, price loans, and structure our credit policy, working closely with a small, senior cross-functional team spanning product, engineering, legal, and commercial. If you've spent years working in secured lending and want to help build something new rather than maintain something old, this is the role.

What You'll Do

  • Define credit policy and underwriting strategy for second charge mortgages, including affordability, eligibility, and decisioning frameworks

  • Own risk scoring and pricing — develop and refine scorecards, risk segmentation, and pricing models that balance volume with portfolio quality

  • Drive growth whilst balancing risk — use analytic and credit judgment to drive growth through credit policy, work with the commercial team team to hit volume targets, and all whilst maintaining portfolio quality

  • Own the IRR/NPV/cashflow models - ensure we understand the economics of the asset we’re booking, and drive changes where needed

  • Design automated decisioning logic — translate credit policy into executable rules and decision trees that can be embedded in the platform, working with engineering to build the quickest, most automated secured product on the market

  • Help shape funding strategy — collaborate with the Capital Markets team to inform investor parameters around LTV limits, property valuations, and portfolio concentration, translating these into practical credit policy

  • Inform the property valuation and security process — ensure credit policy accounts for valuation methodology, panel management considerations, and charge registration requirements

  • Monitor portfolio performance — track early indicators, refine strategy based on outcomes, and report to senior stakeholders

  • Collaborate cross-functionally — work daily with product and engineering to embed credit decisioning into the platform, and with legal and compliance to ensure regulatory alignment (MCOB, Consumer Duty)

  • Get stuck in — this is a small team building something from scratch. You'll be hands-on across the full credit lifecycle, not managing from a distance

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience in secured lending credit risk — you've worked on second charge mortgages or similar secured products (bridging, BTL, specialist residential) and understand the product inside out

  • Strong knowledge of risk scoring and pricing — you've built or materially contributed to scorecards, pricing frameworks, or credit policy in a secured lending environment

  • Understanding of funding and capital constraints — you know how LTV covenants, property valuations, and investor criteria shape what you can lend and to whom

  • Commercial awareness and growth mindset — you understand that credit policy exists to enable lending, not prevent it. You think about accept rates, broker conversion, and competitive positioning alongside risk metrics

  • Familiarity with the end-to-end secured lending process — from quote through to completion, including how valuation, legal, and land registry processes interact with credit decisions

  • Analytical rigour — you're comfortable with data. SQL is required and Python experience is a plus, but what matters is that you think in numbers and can interrogate MI to drive decisions that lead to more good quality lending

  • Regulatory awareness — working knowledge of MCOB and FCA requirements for second charge lending

  • Experience designing for scale and automation — you understand how to structure underwriting policy as decision logic, scorecards, and rules that can be executed programmatically. You think in terms of tens of thousands of applications, not manual case-by-case review

Nice to Have

  • Experience with loan servicing — settlements, collections, arrears management, and recoveries in a secured lending context

  • Exposure to broker distribution models and how credit policy interacts with intermediary channels

  • Experience working in a startup or scale-up environment, or a desire to move from a large organisation into one

  • Experience with decisioning platforms or rules engines

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
